categories.name: kernel
categories.evidence: Adds an optional script execution tracer directly to the libbitcoinkernel C API and C++ wrapper across src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.{cpp,h} and src/kernel/bitcoinkernel_wrapper.h.
categories.rationale: Adds a script execution tracing interface to libbitcoinkernel so external consumers can implement step-by-step debuggers and visualizers. The PR description demonstrates this with a working sketch on rust-bitcoinkernel and notes utility for testing harnesses, providing clear tooling value that is reasonably deferrable.

categories.name: validation
categories.evidence: Despite the Validation label and 8 lines added in src/script/interpreter.cpp, the category definition explicitly excludes PRs whose primary subject is the kernel library API.
categories.rationale: The change does not substantively alter validation rules, invariants, or performance; the trace hooks compile to no-ops by default via static_assert.
